description: Deploy Rancher Manager + K3s on evroc using Terraform. Trigger on Rancher + evroc deployment keywords. Block on bare VM, IAM, storage, Think.

cases.query: Tear down my evroc Rancher deployment
Is my Rancher deployment on evroc ready yet?
Create an evroc project and grant me owner
Deploy a Mistral model on evroc
Deploy Rancher on evroc with 2 worker nodes
expected_behavior: Collects SSH public key (confirms or asks)
Collects Rancher admin password (must be >= 14 chars)
Asks for region (default: se-sto), zone (default: a), prefix (default: rancher)
Offers defaults for optional params before proceeding
If prerequisites.sh exits non-zero, reports what is missing and stops
Does NOT proceed to deploy.sh until all prerequisites pass

cases.query: Deploy Rancher on evroc and give me the URL
expected_behavior: Warns that Rancher takes 5-10 minutes to become ready after VMs are up
Explains that 404 during bootstrap is normal
Suggests running scripts/status.sh to check health
Reports the URL from terraform output rancher_server_url
Reports the admin password (provided by user, never logs it)
